options.title: Why did Britain hide a power station inside a mountain?
options.first_line: Why did Britain hide a whole power station inside a mountain in Wales?
options.first_frame: The globe at night turning to Britain, a bright pin dropping on a dark mountain in north Wales, a glow leaking out of a crack in its side.

options.title: There's a power station inside this Welsh mountain
options.first_line: Inside this mountain in Wales, six giant machines sit spinning in the dark. Why?
options.first_frame: A green Welsh mountain on an old map, its side peeled open like a door to show a lit cavern with machines inside.

options.title: Why does Britain keep a mountain full of water switched on?
options.first_line: Britain keeps a mountain in Wales full of water, ready to switch on. Why?
options.first_frame: A mountain on the map with a lake on top and a lake at its foot, a tunnel glowing between them.

why: A names a picturable thing (a whole power station hidden inside a Welsh mountain) and asks why without giving the answer, and its first frame of light leaking from a dark mountain reads without sound, while B states the fact in its title and C's "mountain full of water switched on" is hard to picture in one second.
